name: Transitions.dev
summary: Library of 43+ crafted UI transitions with copy-ready code, plus a motion skill and motion-fixing agent for coding agents.
description: Production-ready UI transitions for web apps — card resize, number pop-in, badges, dropdowns, modals, text swaps, tabs, shimmer, skeleton loaders and more — as copy-paste snippets (React, TypeScript, Next.js) or as a skill that installs into coding agents (Claude Code, Cursor, Codex). A Builder remixes components with AI credits, and the Transitions Motion Agent scans a codebase, scores its motion and opens fix pull requests. Free tier; Pro plans unlock the full library and Pro skill.
contains: transitions include card resize, number pop-in, notification badge, text swap, menu dropdown, modal open close
more: confetti burst, panel reveal, icon swap, success check, error shake, input clear, skeleton, shimmer text
free skill for Claude Code, Cursor and Codex
free Motion Agent: unlimited scans, a motion score on every pull request, 10 fixes per month
